packageRules.description: Indirect Go deps are disabled by default -- only `tool` directive deps (golang.org/x/vuln) slip through. So when GO-2026-6443/GO-2026-6348 landed against google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1, Renovate raised no bump PR and the v1.83.2 fix had to be hand-added onto an unrelated Actions PR (#27) after govulncheck failed. Enabling indirect deps means Renovate proposes transitive CVE fixes itself; they still land grouped in the Go Minor/Major rules below.

...but not indirect majors. A Go major is a new module path (/vN) that only the dependency importing it can adopt, so Renovate's bump just swaps the require line and `go mod tidy` re-adds the old major at the module graph's minimum version -- in #36 that silently took tools/'s goldmark from 1.7.17 back to 1.7.8, undoing the #30 security bump.

terraform/version.tf pins the urllo provider to 0.0.1 to match ./build-local.sh's local filesystem-mirror build, not a registry release -- this repo IS that provider, so Renovate bumping it against the registry is both circular and wrong for local dev.
GitHub Actions, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
Go modules, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
mise-managed toolchain pins (mise.toml: go, terraform, golangci-lint, python, ruff, coverage), non-major.
mise-managed toolchain pins, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.

description: postUpdateOptions.gomodTidy: Renovate's `go get` only records the /go.mod hashes needed for module-graph resolution, not the h1: zip hashes needed to build a package -- without a tidy, go.sum ships incomplete and `go tool govulncheck` dies with 'missing go.sum entry'. Bit this repo twice (#21, #28). gomodUpdateImportPaths: Renovate skips the tidy on major updates unless this is also set (lib/modules/manager/gomod/artifacts.ts, mustSkipGoModTidy), which is why #36 failed the CI tidy check; it also rewrites /vN import paths so the new major is actually used.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes must not wait for the Monday window -- an empty schedule lets them raise a PR as soon as an advisory lands.
